dog.description_text: This cutie resides at our Westhampton location you can just walk in no appointment needed open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm . If you are interested in meeting them, you can click to submit an online application at Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
